Credential Access.description: Attacks targeting credentials — brute force, credential dumping, hash theft

queries.name: Failed MSSQL Logon Attempt from Public IP
queries.dql: stream=authentication where sourcename='MSSQL' and eid='18456' and srctype='PUBLIC' | groupby srcip, system | select srcip, system, count(*) as cnt | having cnt > 5 | duration 10m
queries.description: Multiple failed MSSQL logins from public IPs — possible external brute force

queries.name: Failed Login Attempt by User to MSSQL Server
queries.dql: stream=authentication where sourcename='MSSQL' and eid='18456' and status='FAILED' | groupby user, system | select user, system, count(*) as cnt | having cnt > 5
queries.description: Repeated failed logins by a user to MSSQL — possible credential stuffing

queries.name: Manual Memory Dumping via Proc Filesystem
queries.dql: stream=auditd where action in ('USER_COMMAND_EXECUTED', 'PROCESS_EXECUTED') and rlike(lower(process), '(cat|grep|tail|less|more|egrep|fgrep|dd|gcore|strings)') and rlike(lower(commandline), '(/proc/.*?/mem|/proc/.*?/maps|/proc/.*?/smaps)') | groupby user, system
queries.description: Linux memory dump via /proc — credential extraction from memory

queries.name: Credential Access via DCE-RPC
queries.dql: stream=NTA-DCE-RPC where ((endpoint='drsuapi' and operation='DRSReplicaSync') or (endpoint='drsuapi' and operation='DRSGetNCChanges')) | groupby srcip
queries.description: DCSync attack — replicating AD credentials over DCE-RPC

queries.name: Possible Impacket SecretDump Remote Activity
queries.dql: stream=NTA-SMB where path like '%ADMIN%' and (name like '%SYSTEM32%' or name like 'tmp') | groupby dstip, srcip
queries.description: Impacket SecretDump indicators over SMB — remote credential extraction

Privilege Escalation.description: Attempts to gain higher access — admin role abuse, UAC bypass, token manipulation

queries.name: MSSQL User Account Added to Sysadmin Role
queries.dql: stream=database where sourcename='MSSQL' and eid='33205' and rlike(lower(query), 'alter server role \[sysadmin\] add member') | groupby system
queries.description: User added to MSSQL sysadmin role — full database privilege escalation

queries.name: UAC Bypass via Windows Firewall Snap-In Hijack
queries.dql: stream=ep-process where eid='1' and parentimage like '%mmc.exe' and parentcommandline like '%WF.msc%' and not image like '%WerFault.exe'
queries.description: UAC bypass using Windows Firewall MMC snap-in

queries.name: Meterpreter or Cobalt Strike Getsystem
queries.dql: stream=ep-process where action='PROCESS_ADDED' and rlike(lower(commandline), '(cmd.exe|compsec.*echo.*pipe|rundll32.*a%p:|mpcmdrun)') and parentimage like '%services.exe%' and eid='1' | groupby system, user
queries.description: Getsystem technique indicators — Meterpreter or Cobalt Strike privilege escalation

queries.name: PowerShell on Compromised Host
queries.dql: stream=ep-image-load where action='PROCESS_ACCESSED' and status='PASSED' and description like '%system%management%automation%' and imageloaded like '%system%management%automation%' | groupby system
queries.description: PowerShell loaded on a flagged host — attacker tooling post-compromise

queries.name: VBA DLL Loaded by Office Application
queries.dql: stream=ep-image-load where action='PROCESS_ACCESSED' and eid='7' and (image like '%excel.exe%' or image like '%winword.exe%' or image like '%powerpnt.exe%' or image like '%outlook.exe%') and imageloaded like '%taskschd.dll%' | groupby system
queries.description: Office application loading task scheduler DLL — macro-based privilege escalation

Lateral Movement.description: Attacker moving through the network — SMB, RDP, PsExec, USB propagation

queries.name: SMB Traffic Permitted From Compromised Host
queries.dql: stream=FIREWALL where action='PACKET_ALLOWED' and dstport=445 | groupby srcip
queries.description: SMB traffic from internal hosts — lateral movement over file shares

queries.name: Excessive Denied SMB Traffic
queries.dql: stream=firewall where action='PACKET_BLOCKED' and dstport=445 | select srcip, count(*) as srccnt | groupby srcip
queries.description: High volume of blocked SMB — scanning or failed lateral movement

queries.name: Suspicious PsExec Execution
queries.dql: stream=NTA-SMB where action in ('SMB_FILE_OPEN', 'SMB_FILE_DELETE') and path like '%C$%' and (name like '%stdin%' or name like '%stdout%' or name like '%stderr%') and not name like '%C$%' and not path like '%PSEXESVC%' | groupby srcip, dstip
queries.description: PsExec indicators on SMB — remote execution tool used for lateral movement

queries.name: External USB Storage Device Detected
queries.dql: stream=win-audit where action='EXTERNAL_DEVICE_PLUGGED' and status='PASSED' and eid='6416' and @ClassName='DiskDrive' | groupby user, system
queries.description: USB drive plugged in — possible removable media-based propagation

queries.name: Suspicious Outbound RDP Connections
queries.dql: stream=ep-network where dstport='3389' and not (image like '%mstsc%exe%' or image like '%RTSApp%exe%' or image like '%RDCMan%exe%') | groupby user, system, dstip | limit 20
queries.description: Outbound RDP from non-standard tools — possible automated lateral movement

Exfiltration.description: Data leaving the environment — large transfers, cloud uploads, SMB to public IPs

queries.name: File Accessed or Downloaded From Restricted Regions
queries.dql: stream=documents where action in ('ACCESSED', 'DOWNLOADED') and srccn in ('CN', 'KP', 'RU', 'IR') | groupby user
queries.description: File access from high-risk countries — possible data theft

queries.name: File Uploaded With Public Access
queries.dql: stream=documents where action='UPLOADED' and status='PASSED' and visibility='PUBLIC' | groupby user
queries.description: Files shared publicly — unintentional or intentional data exposure

queries.name: WebDAV PUT Request
queries.dql: stream=NTA-HTTP where uri like '%WebDAV%' and method like '%PUT%' and srctype='PUBLIC' | groupby srcip
queries.description: Outbound WebDAV upload — file exfiltration over HTTP

queries.name: Large Outbound Transfer High Rate
queries.dql: stream=FIREWALL where srctype='PRIVATE' and dsttype='PUBLIC' and txlen > 200000 | duration 15m | select srcip, count(*) as cnt | groupby srcip | having cnt > 10
queries.description: High-volume outbound data — possible bulk exfiltration

queries.name: External SMB Communication Detected
queries.dql: stream=NTA-SMB where srctype='PUBLIC' or dsttype='PUBLIC' | groupby dstip, srcip
queries.description: SMB traffic to/from public IPs — unusual, possible data exfiltration

Execution.description: Malicious code execution — command shells, scripts, email-borne executables

queries.name: MSSQL xp_cmdshell Command Execution
queries.dql: stream=database where sourcename='MSSQL' and eid='33205' and querytype='EXECUTE' and lower(query) like '%xp_cmdshell%' | groupby system
queries.description: xp_cmdshell used — OS command execution from inside SQL Server

queries.name: MSSQL xp_cmdshell Configuration Change
queries.dql: stream=configuration where sourcename='MSSQL' and eid='15457' and logevent like '%xp_cmdshell%' | groupby system
queries.description: xp_cmdshell enabled or disabled — attacker enabling shell access

queries.name: DNS RCE CVE-2020-1350 (SIGRed)
queries.dql: stream=DNS where RecordType in ('SIG', '0x18') and len(Query) > 50000 and status='FAILED' | groupby srcip
queries.description: SIGRed exploitation attempt — DNS remote code execution

queries.name: Email Attachment with Executable
queries.dql: stream=email-gateway where action='EMAIL_ACCEPTED' and rlike(file, '\.(apk|bat|bin|exe|jar|js|msi|py|scr|sh|vbs|wsf)') | groupby sender
queries.description: Executable file delivered via email — phishing / malware delivery

queries.name: Executable Hidden in Double File Extension
queries.dql: stream=email-gateway where action='EMAIL_ACCEPTED' and rlike(file, '\.(apk|bat|bin|exe|jar|js|msi|py|scr|sh|vbs|wsf)\.') | groupby sender
queries.description: Double extension trick (e.g. invoice.pdf.exe) — disguised malware delivery

Command and Control.description: Attacker C2 communication — DNS beaconing, tunneling, known malware domains

queries.name: Telegram Bot API DNS Request
queries.dql: stream=DNS where query like '%api.telegram.org/bot%' | groupby srcip
queries.description: Telegram Bot API used as C2 channel

queries.name: WannaCry Killswitch Domain
queries.dql: stream=DNS where query in ('ifferfsodp9ifjaposdfjhgosurijfaewrwergwea.com', 'iuqssfsodp9ifjaposdfjhgosurijfaewrwergwea.com', 'ayylmaotjhsstasdfasdfasdfasdfasdfasdfasdf.com') | groupby srcip
queries.description: WannaCry ransomware killswitch domain lookup — active infection indicator

queries.name: Suspicious Base64 Encoded DNS Query
queries.dql: stream=DNS where rlike(query, '[A-Za-z0-9\+\/]+={1,2}\.') | groupby srcip
queries.description: Base64 in DNS query — DNS tunneling or data exfiltration over DNS

queries.name: Cobalt Strike DNS Beaconing
queries.dql: stream=DNS where (query like 'aaa.stage.%' or query like 'post.1%') | groupby srcip
queries.description: Cobalt Strike DNS beacon patterns — active C2 communication

queries.name: Communication to Ngrok Tunneling Service
queries.dql: stream=ep-network where action='NETWORK_CONNECTION' and rlike(lower(dsthost), 'tunnel\.(us|eu|ap|au|sa|jp|in)\.ngrok\.com') | groupby user, system, dsthost
queries.description: Ngrok tunnel used — attacker routing C2 traffic through legitimate tunnel

Initial Access.description: Entry points — exposed RDP, web exploits, phishing, supply chain

queries.name: Publicly Accessible RDP Service
queries.dql: stream=NTA-RDP where action='CONNECTION_ESTABLISHED' and srctype='PUBLIC' | groupby dstip, srcip
queries.description: RDP connection established from public internet — exposed remote access

queries.name: Multiple Suspicious HTTP Response Codes from Single Client
queries.dql: stream=webserver where returncode in ('400', '401', '403', '500') | groupby system, srcip | select system, srcip, count(*) as agg | having agg > 10
queries.description: Scanner or attacker probing web application — error code spike from one source

queries.name: Twig Sort Filter Exploitation Attempt
queries.dql: stream=webserver where uriquery rlike '\|sort\((\'|")?(eval|system|exec|passthru|shell_exec|popen|proc_open)' | groupby srcip
queries.description: Twig template injection via sort filter — server-side template injection attack

queries.name: Citrix ADS Exploitation (CVE-2020-8193/8195)
queries.dql: stream=webserver where (url like '%/rapi/filedownload_filter=path:%2F%') | groupby system
queries.description: Citrix ADC exploitation attempt — path traversal via known CVE

queries.name: SolarWinds C2 Host Name Detected
queries.dql: stream=WEBFILTER where (url like '%avsvmcloud%com%' or url like '%databasegalore%com%' or url like '%deftsecurity%com%' or url like '%panhardware%com%' or url like '%thedoccloud%com%') | groupby srcip
queries.description: Known SolarWinds SUNBURST C2 domains — supply chain compromise indicator

Defense Evasion.description: Attackers hiding activity — log tampering, MFA disable, masquerading

queries.name: Audit Log Tampering in MSSQL
queries.dql: stream=database where sourcename='MSSQL' and eid='33205' and querytype in ('ALTER', 'DROP') and lower(query) like '%server audit%' | groupby system
queries.description: ALTER or DROP on MSSQL audit objects — attacker covering tracks

queries.name: MFA Disabled for GCP User
queries.dql: stream=iam where sourcename='G-SUITE' and action='UNENROLL_USER_FROM_STRONG_AUTH' | groupby user, targetuser
queries.description: MFA unenrolled — attacker weakening authentication controls

queries.name: Suspicious Kernel Feature Activity on Linux
queries.dql: stream=auditd where action='PROCESS_EXECUTED' and rlike(lower(commandline), '(/etc/sysctl.conf|/proc/sys/kernel/|/proc/sys/vm/|grsecurity)') | groupby user, system
queries.description: Kernel parameter tampering on Linux — disabling security features

queries.name: Bitsadmin to Uncommon TLD
queries.dql: stream=webfilter where (useragent like '%Microsoft BITS/%') and not (domain like '%.com' or domain like '%.net' or domain like '%.org' or domain like '%.edu' or domain like '%.gov') | groupby srcip
queries.description: BITS job downloading from unusual domain — LOLBin abuse for stealthy download

queries.name: Flash Player Update from Suspicious Location
queries.dql: stream=webfilter where (url like '%/install_flash_player.exe' or url like '%/flash_install.php%') and not (domain like '%.adobe.com/%') | groupby srcip
queries.description: Fake Flash update from non-Adobe domain — masquerading as legitimate software

Impact.description: Destructive actions — data destruction, ransomware, DoS, crypto mining

queries.name: DROP or ALTER on MSSQL Database
queries.dql: stream=database where sourcename='MSSQL' and eid='33205' and rlike(lower(query), '(drop|truncate) (table|database)') | groupby system
queries.description: Destructive database commands — data destruction or sabotage

queries.name: DNS NXDOMAIN Flood
queries.dql: stream=DNS where action='DNS_QUERIED' and responsecode='NXDOMAIN' and status='FAILED' | groupby srcip | select srcip, count(*) as count | having count > 500
queries.description: High-volume NXDOMAIN responses — DNS amplification or DoS attack

queries.name: High DNS Requests From Same Source
queries.dql: stream=DNS where action='REQUEST_ALLOWED' and status='PASSED' | groupby srcip | select srcip, count(action) as totalcount | having totalcount > 10000
queries.description: Single source generating massive DNS traffic — DoS or DNS tunneling

queries.name: In-Browser Crypto Mining
queries.dql: stream=EP-NETWORK where (image like '%iexplore%exe' or image like '%chrome%exe%' or image like '%firefox%exe%') and dstport in ('3333', '4444', '5555', '7777', '9999', '14444') | groupby user
queries.description: Browser connecting to mining pool ports — cryptojacking

queries.name: Ransomware Decryption Instructions Created
queries.dql: stream=ep-file where action='FILE_CREATED' and rlike(lower(targetfilename), '(decrypt|readme|recover|restore|how_to|unlock|ransom|contact).*?\.(txt|html|hta|bmp|png|lnk)') | groupby system, user
queries.description: Ransom note files created — active ransomware encryption in progress

Persistence.description: Mechanisms for maintaining access — scheduled tasks, account manipulation, backdoors

queries.name: Stored Procedure Set to Auto-Execute on SQL Startup
queries.dql: stream=database where sourcename='MSSQL' and eid='33205' and querytype='EXECUTE' and query like '%sp_procoption%' | groupby system
queries.description: SQL Server startup procedure configured — backdoor or persistence in database

queries.name: Mailbox Permission Added and Removed Quickly
queries.dql: stream=iam where action in ('MAILBOX_PERMISSION_ADDED', 'MAILBOX_PERMISSION_REMOVED') | duration 30m | select user, distinct_count(action) as cnt_action | groupby user | having cnt_action==2
queries.description: Mailbox permission rapidly added then removed — covert access then cleanup

queries.name: Same User Enabled and Disabled in Short Time
queries.dql: stream=IAM where (action='USER_DISABLED' or action='USER_ENABLED') | duration 30m | select user, targetuser, distinct_count(action) as countaction | groupby user, targetuser | having countaction==2
queries.description: Account enabled then disabled quickly — temporary account for persistence

queries.name: Remote Task Creation via ATSVC Named Pipe
queries.dql: stream=NTA-SMB where path like '%C$%' and name like '%ATSVC%' | groupby name
queries.description: Remote scheduled task creation over SMB — lateral persistence

queries.name: Pulse Secure Arbitrary File Reading (CVE-2019-11510)
queries.dql: stream=threat where action='THREAT_DETECTED' and vector='HOST' and (url like '%dana%guacamole%' or url like '%lmdb%data.mdb%' or url like '%data%mtmp%system%') | groupby srcip, system
queries.description: Pulse Secure VPN exploit attempt — file reading vulnerability used to maintain access
